AI Powered Functional Testing
Home
AI Powered Functional Testing
AI-driven functional testing and consulting capabilities
Deliver Faster, Smarter and More Reliable Software with AI-Powered Testing
Modern applications are evolving faster than ever. Frequent releases, complex integrations and demanding user expectations make traditional functional testing increasingly difficult to scale.
Market Cloud’s AI-Powered Functional Testing services
combine intelligent automation, advanced test engineering and human expertise to help organisations validate critical business functionality, accelerate regression testing and improve software quality.
From web and mobile applications to enterprise platforms, APIs and complex business workflows, our approach helps you identify defects earlier, increase test coverage and release with greater confidence.
Market Cloud's AI Powered Functional Testing
Meet Functional Requirements
Validate features, workflows and business logic to ensure your application performs exactly as expected.
Detect Defects Earlier
Identify functional issues early in development to reduce rework, delays and production-related problems.
Reduce Quality Costs
Resolve defects sooner to lower testing effort, development rework and avoidable post-release support costs.
Improve User Experience
Deliver reliable workflows and smoother interactions that improve usability, consistency and overall user satisfaction.
Flexible Delivery Models
Flexible Software Quality Solutions
Market Cloud can support functional testing through different engagement models depending on your internal capability, project requirements and delivery timeline.
QA Test Consulting
Get specialist guidance on testing strategy, functional coverage, QA processes and quality improvement.
Managed Testing Services
Extend your delivery capability with an experienced QA team managing agreed testing activities across your project or application lifecycle.
QA Talent Augmentation
Add skilled testers to your existing delivery teams when additional capacity or specialist testing expertise is required.
Our Functional Testing Approach
Understand the Business Requirement
We review your application, functional requirements, business processes, integrations and critical user journeys.
Design the Testing Strategy
Our QA specialists define relevant scenarios, test cases, data requirements and areas of functional risk.
Execute and Analyse
We validate application behaviour against expected outcomes, identify defects and document findings clearly for development teams.
Retest and Support Release Readiness
Resolved defects are retested, affected functionality is validated and remaining risks are communicated before release.
Why Us?
Smarter Functional Testing with AI
AI-assisted functional testing combines AI-driven insights with expert QA to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and efficiently validate business logic, workflows, integrations, and user journeys while keeping human expertise at the centre.
Benefits:
Faster test design
Improved test coverage
Requirement-to-test traceability
Reduced manual effort
Consistent test scenario generation
